class.name: SteamDlcListResult
class.brief_description: Outcome of a Steam DLC catalog query.
class.description: Returned by [method SteamApps.dlc]. Check [member SteamResult.ok] before using the catalog. A successful query can contain zero entries.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns a detached typed array containing this result's catalog records.

members.member: Read-only catalog payload. Reading this property gives a separate array, and an error result has an empty payload.
